game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of moon crystals while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: In Relic Vault, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of moon crystals while keeping the order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the rune scholar ahead. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the moon altar by solving code steps involving clean_list that move the rune scholar forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the moon altar first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Relic Vault'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
